description: Removes hidden metadata (GPS location, camera or phone model, serial numbers, dates, author, software, AI-generation labels and credentials) from videos (MP4, MOV, M4V, 3GP, MKV, WebM), PDFs, camera RAW files (CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, RW2, DNG) and photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP). Each file is sent to the AI Metadata Cleaner server, cleaned, and a clean copy is saved next to the original as "<name>-clean.<ext>". Originals are never changed. Video and audio are not re-encoded. Pass files or folders (a folder means the supported files directly inside it). Each file uses one job from the monthly allowance. At most 50 files per call.

image_mode.description: Photos only. "reencode" (default) rebuilds the image, the most thorough. "strip" removes metadata without touching the pixels.

keep_pdf_signature.description: PDFs only. Keep a digital signature (it carries the signer and signing date). Default false: signatures are removed.

output_dir.description: Folder to save clean copies in. Default: next to each original.

paths.description: Absolute paths to files or folders. ~ is allowed.

name: clean_files
title: Remove metadata from files
